name: Sindo Yageuneul Hanayo?
source:
"I'm a god? But I have to go to work tomorrow..."

Previously an ordinary office worker, "I" suddenly gain the power of a god on the way home from work. Though I have no interest in things like gods, and would rather live a quiet life as an office worker.. Four extremely seductive men keep showing up.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5306800/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“我是神明？可我明天还得去上班啊……”

原本只是普通上班族的“我”，在某天下班回家的路上突如其来地获得了神明的力量。尽管“我”对神仙之类的事毫无兴趣，只想安安稳稳地过好社畜的平静生活……四个魅力撩人的男人却接二连三地找上了门。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5306800/]Steam[/url]]
